name: Claude Code GPT Factory Prompt ⚙️
description_md:
# What You Get

- The exact mega-prompt that auto-generates a complete custom GPT project (concise instructions + research-backed knowledge base) in minutes.

- Enforces core instructions under 7,500 characters with explicit references to knowledge-base .md files for every answer and workflow.

- Produces a clean folder tree in Markdown (instructions, knowledge-base with core-concepts/procedures/best-practices/troubleshooting/resources, examples, project overview).

- Built-in research guidelines so your agent pulls from authoritative sources, adds frontmatter, and cross-links related docs.

- Drop-in [BUSINESS/USE CASE CONTEXT] placeholder—paste your business/tasks and get tailored assistants instantly.

- Works smoothly in Claude Code or Cursor (or any AI editor with file generation & web search): just paste and run.

- Deliverable: the prompt text only
Want even more AI goodness?
